art_direction: The Invisible, Made Visible — deep navy dominant ground, luminous light-blue and brand amber sharp accents. Money-light motif moving from darkness to light. Dark editorial sections alternating with light ones mirroring opaque vs transparent.

typography.pairing_strategy: Distinctive serif display paired with clean geometric sans. Avoid Inter/Roboto. Echoes original Garamond + Avenir pairing but upgraded.
typography.scale_rules: H1 up to text-6xl (mobile text-4xl). Massive stats like $44,000,000 can be text-[8vw] leading-none tracking-tighter.

visual_enhancers.spotlight_treatment: Use radial gradients in the background to create a spotlight effect in dark sections, focusing on the content.
visual_enhancers.parallax: Subtle parallax on real photography. Clipped frames for images.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use on sticky nav and overlay cards over dark sections. No pure transparent backgrounds for headers.
visual_enhancers.bento_grid: For the Four Transparency Pillars (Exact Claims Paid, Reserves & Admin Costs, All Compensation, Carrier Charges).

sections_and_layouts: Sticky Nav: Glassmorphism header, solid contrast on scroll. Links: How It Works, Program Services, Our Story, Our Team, Contact + Get Started.
Kinetic Hero: 'A CFO For Your Voluntary Benefits', massive $44,000,000 stat counter, money-light motif.
Four Transparency Pillars: Bento grid highlighting the 4 pillars with icons and short text.
25% Savings Stat Moment: Full width, dark background, massive typography.
Blue Check-up Banner: Luminous light-blue background, bold amber CTA.
How It Works: 'We Make the Invisible, Visible', 6 reinvestment options, and a 60-second video poster card.
Our Story: Editorial section with founder Amy Hollis spotlight.
Our Team & Advisory: Grid of 10 team members + strip of 10 advisory members.
Marquee Band: Continuous scrolling text or client logos.

hero_motif.description: Lit up dollar sign in the dark, fitting the money-light motif.

founder_spotlight.description: Professional woman in black blazer, used for Founder Amy Hollis.

video_poster.description: Culturally diverse team engaged in a serious business discussion in an office setting. Used for 60-second video poster.

team_placeholder.description: Professional woman on focus. Re-use or mix with other Unsplash professional avatars for the 10-person grids.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA standards. Light-blue and amber accents must have dark text if used as backgrounds.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: You must create a React single-page application based on these exact guidelines.
Use framer-motion for staggering text and scroll reveals (e.g., whileInView).
Use react-countup for the $44,000,000 and 25% stats.
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling inside a useEffect at the root component.
Alternate sections between deep navy and stark white to represent invisible/visible.
Ensure all interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) have a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='contact-submit-button').
Never use pure transparent backgrounds for the sticky header; always use backdrop-blur and a semi-transparent fill.
Use Lucide-react for any icons required (e.g., arrows, pillars, checks).
Create the .js (not .tsx) files since the project uses JS.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not center-align everything. Use asymmetry and grid structures.
Avoid AI-slop gradients. Use solid colors with subtle lighting (radial gradients) to create depth in dark sections.
Ensure micro-animations on all buttons and hover states.
Ensure images are clipped inside structured frames with subtle hover parallax.
